title: Tim Taylor's hooded figure before his invention download

tellings.quote: morning he said grant the last thing I remember the night before I got that idea in my head I woke up and there was a hooded figure standing at the end of bed

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, on Jesse Michels's podcast, relays what Tim Taylor, a man featured in a book by scholar Diana Pasulka, told him. Cameron says Taylor told him that the night before an invention idea arrived in his head, he woke up to see a hooded figure standing at the end of his bed. The story ties the sudden idea to a visit from some unknown being.
